home.title: Info Lens
home.subtitle: A toolbox for exploring the informational nature of LLMs and language
home.description: Info Lens is a toolbox for exploring the informational nature of LLMs and language. LLM Causal Flow - explore the context-attribution DAG, Info Highlight - highlight the 'informative' parts, Semantic Highlight - search and highlight words by meaning

infoHighlight.title: Info Highlight
infoHighlight.subtitle: - highlight the 'informative' parts
infoHighlight.description: Info Highlight heatmaps per-token surprisal (bits) so you linger on informative words and skim predictable ones. Works on pages and PDFs. Local WebGPU analysis is free.

semanticHighlight.title: Semantic Highlight
semanticHighlight.subtitle: - search and highlight words by meaning

chat.title: LLM Raw Chat
chat.subtitle: - chat with explicit raw prompts
chat.description: LLM Raw Chat is an Info Lens tool for talking to a language model with explicit raw prompts, system text, and teacher forcing.

attribution.title: Context Attribution
attribution.subtitle: - attribute a predicted token to its context
attribution.description: Context Attribution shows which context tokens a language model uses when predicting a target token. An Info Lens toolbox page.

causalFlow.title: LLM Causal Flow
causalFlow.subtitle: - explore the context-attribution DAG
causalFlow.description: LLM Causal Flow draws a DAG of how a language model attributes a predicted token to its context. Explore information flow in generated text on Info Lens.

info-highlight.html.description: Info Highlight heatmaps per-token surprisal (bits) so you linger on informative words and skim predictable ones. Works on pages and PDFs. Local WebGPU analysis is free.
info-highlight.html.descriptionZh: Info Highlight 用语言模型计算每个词的信息量（比特）并画成热力图，便于细读信息量大的词、略读可预测的部分。支持网页和 PDF。本机 WebGPU 分析免费。

info-highlight-privacy.html.description: Privacy policy for the Info Highlight Chrome extension: on-device analysis, cloud analysis, credits, and anonymous usage stats.
info-highlight-privacy.html.descriptionZh: Info Highlight Chrome 扩展的隐私政策：本机分析、云端分析、额度与匿名使用统计。

compare.html.description: Compare two Info Highlight analyses side by side. Part of the Info Lens toolbox.
